ional — but the `configDirty` flags also persist. Let me check:

ched fresh).

reset to `false` either on a successful save (line 173) or when the
user confirms "Discard" (line 69). There's no reset on `renderConfig()` re-

entry.

Scenario: User opens config, makes changes, navigates away WITHOUT saving, then navigates back. `
configDirty.general` is still `true`. They immediately try to switch to "Persona Models" tab → spur
ious "You have unsaved changes. Discard them?" dialog appears, even though the page just

re-fetched fresh config from the server.

This is a real UX bug — though
a low-to-medium severity one. The developer's
handoff notes explicitly say `configActiveTab` not resetting is

configDirty` persistence issue. The fix would be to reset all dirty flags to `false` at the top of `renderConfig()` or in

`renderConfigPage()`.
